items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know that. [regarding Duke being a painter]

ctx.x: And it was something that grew slowly on me, but when Dizzy would sing to me, what he was doing and what Charlie Parker was doing, I heard it then, where I didn't hear it instantly when Charlie Parker was doing it.

You have got to understand something. You have lived this music, you see. I am just talking about a man who idolized one person. He didn't idolize Duke Ellington and Louis. He idolized Lester, that was all there was to it, and everything he ever wrote, if he wrote
it was about Lester Young, a short story^A everything he wrote was about Lester Young.
